title: Clone, Commit, and Push
description:
**SITUATION:**

You just joined Forgeboard as an intern on the **Core** team. Everyone contributes to the same codebase — sprint-service — hosted at `git.forgeboard.internal`. Your laptop does not have a copy yet; you need to clone it into your home directory before you can change anything.

Forgeboard supports **agentic sprints** as well as classic ones. The feature is still in **beta**, so every enterprise only gets a limited option set. Yesterday Core decided to roll the **full** toolkit out to two early-access enterprises and watch how it goes: `helix-robotics` and `lumen-retail`.

Jordan asked you to flip those two tenants to `full` in `config/app.conf`, commit the change, and push it on `main` so the rest of Core can see it. Leave every other line alone — including the global default and every other tenant.

Nothing is under `~/sprint-service` until you clone. Configure your Git identity before you commit.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. From your home directory, clone the team repo at `learner@git.forgeboard.internal:/srv/git/sprint-service.git` so you have `~/sprint-service`.
2. Set your Git identity to name `Ada Learner` and email `ada@forgeboard.internal`.
3. In `config/app.conf`, under `[agentic_sprints.tenants]`, set `helix-robotics` and `lumen-retail` to `full`. Leave every other line alone.
4. Commit that change with a short message that says what you changed, then push it to `origin` on `main`. Leave a clean working tree.

hints: Git won't commit until it knows your name: `git config --global user.name "Ada Learner"`, then the same for `user.email` (`ada@forgeboard.internal`).
Before you commit, `git diff` should show exactly two changed lines under `[agentic_sprints.tenants]` (`helix-robotics` and `lumen-retail`).
After `git commit`, run `git push origin main`. Submit checks the team remote on git.forgeboard.internal, not only your laptop copy.

problemStatement.brief: Clone, set identity, flip two early-access tenants to `full`, commit, push `main`.
problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Clone, Commit, and Push

Core's git host is **git.forgeboard.internal**. Clone over SSH, change config, commit, and push.

## 1. Clone into your home directory

Nothing is pre-placed under `~/sprint-service`. Clone from home so Git creates the folder:

```bash
cd ~
git clone learner@git.forgeboard.internal:/srv/git/sprint-service.git
cd sprint-service
git remote -v
git log --oneline
```

One commit from Priya. `origin` points at `learner@git.forgeboard.internal:...`.

## 2. Configure your identity

Git refuses to commit without a name and email:

```bash
git config --global user.name "Ada Learner"
git config --global user.email "ada@forgeboard.internal"
git config --global --list | grep user
```

## 3. Edit the config

Flip only **helix-robotics** and **lumen-retail** to `full`. Leave `agentic_sprints_default` and every other tenant on `beta`.

```bash
nano config/app.conf
git diff
```

`git diff` should show exactly two changed lines under `[agentic_sprints.tenants]`.

## 4. Stage, commit, and push

```bash
git add config/app.conf
git commit -m "Enable full agentic sprints for early-access enterprises"
git push origin main
git status
git log --oneline
```

Then **Submit**. The grader checks identity, your local commit, that only those two tenant flags changed, and that **remote `main` matches your HEAD**.
